quality.basis: 第五类构建失败：注入改的是 Flight SQL 代码，OSS-Fuzz 构建不编译它，两个版本的所有程序完全相同

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the changed file is Flight SQL code that the OSS-Fuzz build.sh never compiles (it builds no Flight/Flight-SQL), so the vulnerable and secure builds are byte-identical and no built program contains the injected change.

review.note: a data race; ThreadSanitizer SEGVs in its own code

category5.design: The injected change removes a shared_lock in FlightSession::GetSessionOption, a data race. Flight SQL is not part of the arrow OSS-Fuzz build, so no built fuzzer or binary contains the function; the two builds are identical and no PoV can tell them apart. The spec keeps the project's own fuzzer and marks the task unusable (the exploit builds a ThreadSanitizer program of its own copy of the function, not of arrow).
